items.title: Testing human ability to detect ‘deepfake’ images of human faces

judge.evidence_empirical: "Using an online survey, participants (N = 280) were randomly allocated to one of four groups: a control group, and three assistance interventions."
judge.evidence_topic: "Este estudo visa avaliar a capacidade humana de identificar imagens deepfake de rostos humanos"
judge.reason: O artigo trata da detecção humana de deepfakes, possui dados próprios com 280 participantes, o método descrito confere com o resumo, e o achado principal está totalmente sustentado pelo trecho citado.

items.title: Warning: Humans cannot reliably detect speech deepfakes

judge.evidence_empirical: We presented genuine and deepfake audio to n = 529 individuals and asked them to identify the deepfakes.
judge.evidence_topic: Speech deepfakes are artificial voices generated by machine learning models. ... We presented genuine and deepfake audio to n = 529 individuals and asked them to identify the deepfakes.
judge.reason: O artigo trata diretamente da detecção de deepfakes de fala (áudio sintético) por ouvintes humanos. É um estudo empírico experimental que relata coleta de dados própria com n = 529 participantes. O tipo de estudo e o método extraídos coincidem com o resumo (teste de detecção em dois idiomas, com exemplo de deepfakes). O achado principal extraído (taxa de acerto de 73%, sem diferença entre idiomas) é textualmente sustentado pelo resumo: 'Listeners only correctly spotted the deepfakes 73% of the time, and there was no difference in detectability between the two languages.'

items.title: Fooled twice: People cannot detect deepfakes but think they can

judge.evidence_empirical: pre-registered behavioral experiment ( N = 210)
judge.evidence_topic: Hyper-realistic manipulation of audio-visual content, i.e., deepfakes... people cannot reliably detect deepfakes
judge.reason: O achado extraído (pessoas não detectam deepfakes confiavelmente, tendem a tomá-los por autênticos e superestimam sua capacidade) é integralmente sustentado pelo resumo, que afirma que 'people cannot reliably detect deepfakes', 'biased towards mistaking deepfakes as authentic' e 'overestimate their own detection abilities'.

items.title: Deepfake detection by human crowds, machines, and machine-informed crowds

judge.evidence_empirical: In two online studies with 15,016 participants, we present authentic videos and deepfakes and ask participants to identify which is which.
judge.evidence_topic: Are humans or the leading machine learning model more capable of detecting algorithmic visual manipulations of videos?
judge.reason: O artigo trata diretamente da detecção de deepfakes por humanos, é empírico com participantes humanos, o método extraído corresponde ao descrito, e o achado principal é integralmente sustentado por trechos do resumo.

items.title: AI-generated images of familiar faces are indistinguishable from real photographs

judge.evidence_empirical: Our results demonstrated that generated images of both fictional (Experiment 1) and celebrity identities (Experiment 2) could not be distinguished from real photographs.
judge.evidence_topic: Human users are now able to generate synthetic face images with artificial intelligence (AI) tools.
judge.reason: The article fits the topic as it investigates human perception of AI-generated face images. It reports multiple experiments with human participants, and the extracted findings directly match the abstract.

items.title: AI-synthesized faces are indistinguishable from real faces and more trustworthy

judge.evidence_empirical: Our evaluation of the photorealism of AI-synthesized faces indicates that synthesis engines have passed through the uncanny valley and are capable of creating faces that are indistinguishable-and more trustworthy-than real faces.
judge.evidence_topic: Our evaluation of the photorealism of AI-synthesized faces indicates that synthesis engines have passed through the uncanny valley and are capable of creating faces that are indistinguishable-and more trustworthy-than real faces.
judge.reason: O artigo trata diretamente da percepção humana sobre credibilidade de rostos sintéticos. O resumo descreve uma avaliação empírica de fotorrealismo e confiabilidade, compatível com estudos com participantes humanos. O método extraído corresponde ao resumo. O achado principal é exatamente sustentado pelo trecho citado.

items.title: AI Hyperrealism: Why AI Faces Are Perceived as More Real Than Human Ones

judge.evidence_empirical: In Experiment 1 ( N = 124 adults), ... In Experiment 2 ( N = 610 adults)
judge.evidence_topic: White AI faces are judged as human more often than actual human faces—a phenomenon we term AI hyperrealism.
judge.reason: O artigo investiga a percepção de rostos gerados por IA, atendendo ao tema. É empírico, com dois experimentos com participantes humanos. O método extraído coincide com o resumo. O achado principal é sustentado diretamente pelo resumo.

items.title: Training human super-recognizers’ detection and discrimination of AI-generated faces

judge.evidence_empirical: In two different experimental designs, we found that SRs (total N = 283) were better at detecting and discriminating synthetic faces than controls (total N = 381)
judge.evidence_topic: Here, we investigate synthetic face detection and discrimination in super-recognizers (SRs; who have exceptional face recognition skills), and typical-ability control participants.
judge.reason: O achado principal extraído é sustentado pelo resumo, que relata que SRs foram melhores na detecção e discriminação de rostos sintéticos e que o treinamento melhorou o desempenho em ambos os grupos.

items.title: Crowds Improve Human Detection of <scp>AI</scp>‐Synthesised Faces

judge.evidence_empirical: In Experiment 1, participants viewed synthetic and real faces, and rated whether they thought each face was synthetic or real using a 1–7 scale.
judge.evidence_topic: Artificial intelligence can now synthesise face images which people cannot distinguish from real faces. Here, we investigated the wisdom of the (outer) crowd ... as routes to increased performance.
judge.reason: O resumo descreve dois experimentos com participantes humanos julgando a autenticidade de rostos sintéticos gerados por IA, o que se alinha ao pedido (detecção de imagens sintéticas por pessoas). O método extraído reflete fielmente o resumo, e o achado relatado é integralmente sustentado pela evidência do resumo.

items.title: Providing detection strategies to improve human detection of deepfakes: An experimental study

judge.evidence_empirical: In this preregistered online experiment, participants (N = 454, Mage = 37.19, SDage = 13.25, males = 57.5%) categorize a series of 20 videos as either real or deepfake.
judge.evidence_topic: Deepfake videos are becoming more pervasive. ... participants ... categorize a series of 20 videos as either real or deepfake.
judge.reason: O estudo aborda diretamente a detecção humana de deepfakes (vídeos sintéticos) e é um experimento empírico com dados próprios de 454 participantes. O achado principal extraído reflete fielmente o resumo, que relata 60,70% de acurácia e ausência de efeito da intervenção.

items.title: Deepfake detection with and without content warnings

judge.evidence_empirical: We conduct an experiment
judge.evidence_topic: measure people's alertness to and ability to detect a high-quality deepfake among a set of videos.
judge.reason: O artigo aborda a detecção de deepfakes por humanos, utilizando experimento com participantes, conforme exigido pelo pedido. O achado principal está totalmente apoiado pelo resumo.

items.title: Effects of Browsing Conditions and Visual Alert Design on Human Susceptibility to Deepfakes

judge.evidence_empirical: we operationalized four such conditions ... and found in a series of online experiments that all conditions lowered detection
judge.evidence_topic: The increasing reach of deepfakes raises practical questions about people’s ability to detect false videos online.
judge.reason: O resumo confirma que o artigo trata da percepção humana de deepfakes por meio de experimentos online, abordando condições de navegação e assistência de IA. Os dados extraídos (tipo de estudo, método e achado) estão todos respaldados no resumo.

items.title: Assessing the perceived credibility of deepfakes: The impact of system-generated cues and video characteristics

judge.evidence_empirical: This article conducted two randomized controlled 2 × 2 × 2 experiments ( N = 518) to explore the influence of heuristic cues (including the number of followers, popularity, and description as variables) generated by the system and video characteristics (including definition, duration, and editing as variables).
judge.evidence_topic: less is known about what affects individuals’ credibility judgments concerning deepfakes.
judge.reason: O artigo trata diretamente da percepção de credibilidade de deepfakes, relata dois experimentos empíricos com participantes humanos, e o achado extraído (associação positiva de seguidores e popularidade, e deepfakes em alta definição enganam mais) é inteiramente respaldado pelo resumo.

items.title: Deciphering authenticity in the age of AI: how AI-generated disinformation images and AI detection tools influence judgements of authenticity

judge.evidence_empirical: In this study, 292 UK-based participants were presented with both AI-generated and non-AI-generated disinformation images which varied in aesthetic realism and emotional salience.
judge.evidence_topic: how aesthetic realism and emotional salience, as key features of both AI-generated content and disinformation, may influence authenticity judgements of AI-generated disinformation images.
judge.reason: O estudo investiga experimentalmente como pessoas julgam a autenticidade de imagens geradas por IA, cumprindo todos os critérios de inclusão: é empírico, com participantes humanos, não foca em políticos/eleições e relata dados próprios. O achado extraído corresponde exatamente ao resumo.

items.title: Conspiracy thinking and social media use are associated with ability to detect deepfakes

judge.evidence_empirical: The aim of the current study was to investigate the predictors of human performance at recognizing deepfake videos.
judge.evidence_topic: The aim of the current study was to investigate the predictors of human performance at recognizing deepfake videos.
judge.reason: O artigo apresenta um estudo empírico sobre o reconhecimento humano de deepfakes, alinhado ao pedido, com método adequado ao resumo e achado integralmente respaldado.

items.title: Detecting Deepfakes Through Emotion?: Facial Expression and Emotional Contagion as Dual Indicators of Deepfake Credibility

judge.evidence_empirical: we conducted an audience response analysis to assess how displayed emotions in the two types of videos transfer to viewers' emotional experiences and their subsequent assessments of the videos
judge.evidence_topic: investigates how these discrepancies influence viewers' emotional reactions and perceptions of video credibility
judge.reason: O artigo trata da percepção de credibilidade de vídeos deepfake por espectadores humanos, atendendo ao pedido. É um estudo empírico com coleta de dados de resposta da audiência. O método e o achado extraídos correspondem exatamente ao resumo.

items.title: Deepfake smiles matter less—the psychological and neural impact of presumed AI-generated faces

judge.evidence_empirical: Using EEG, we tracked participants’ (N = 30) brain responses to real faces showing positive, neutral, and negative expressions, after being informed that they are either real or fake.
judge.evidence_topic: Here we investigate the impact of the belief that depicted persons are real or deepfakes on psychological and neural measures of human face perception.
judge.reason: O artigo investiga como a crença de que um rosto é real ou gerado por IA (deepfake) afeta a percepção humana, medindo respostas psicológicas e neurais. Isso corresponde ao tema de percepção de imagens sintéticas. O estudo é empírico, com coleta e análise de dados próprios (N=30, EEG e avaliações). O método extraído está em conformidade com o resumo. O achado principal sobre sorrisos falsos ser percebidos como menos positivos e sem efeitos neurais típicos é integralmente sustentado pelo resumo.

items.title: UNMASKING MEDIA ILLUSION: ANALYTICAL SURVEY OF DEEPFAKE VIDEO DETECTION AND EMOTIONAL INSIGHTS

judge.evidence_empirical: A comprehensive survey administered to 71 participants from two Midwestern universities collected data on psychological and cognitive factors, digital literacy levels, demographics, and deepfake detection abilities. The survey incorporated deepfake and genuine videos to assess participants' identification accuracy and confidence levels.
judge.evidence_topic: investigates the psychological and demographic factors influencing the ability to detect deepfake videos
judge.reason: O achado está completamente alinhado com o resumo, que relata correlações significativas entre letramento digital, vieses cognitivos e desempenho na detecção de deepfakes.

items.title: The Relationship of Digital Literacy, Exposure to AI-Generated Deepfake Videos, and the Ability to Identify Deepfakes in Generation X Hubungan Literasi Digital, Paparan Video Deepfake yang Dihasilkan AI, dan Kemampuan untuk Mengidentifikasi Deepfake pada Generasi X

judge.evidence_empirical: Melalui survei yang melibatkan 199 responden
judge.evidence_topic: Studi ini mengeksplorasi hubungan literasi digital, paparan video deepfake yang dihasilkan AI, dan kemampuan untuk mengidentifikasi deepfake
judge.reason: O artigo trata da detecção humana de deepfakes; é empírico com survey; o método extraído combina com o resumo; o achado é plenamente suportado: baixa capacidade e não influenciada pelo letramento ou exposição.

items.title: Comparing AI and humans’ ability to recognize AI-generated images

judge.evidence_empirical: The study prompted humans and machines to classify 80 images of four categories (animal, architecture, landscape, and vehicle) as real or generated. Experiment results show that...
judge.evidence_topic: This study compares humans’ ability to recognize AI-generated images to that of AI models designed to detect these images.
judge.reason: O achado resume corretamente os resultados do experimento conforme o resumo, que menciona o melhor desempenho em imagens reais, desempenho similar nas geradas e a ajuda das limitações dos modelos aos humanos.

items.title: Effect of AI Performance, Risk Perception, and Trust on Human Dependence in Deepfake Detection AI System

judge.evidence_empirical: Through an online human subject experiment involving 400 participants

items.title: Assessing the visual appeal of real/AI-generated food images

judge.evidence_empirical: Two online experiments were conducted with real and AI-generated food images stretching across the unprocessed, processed, and ultra-processed food continuum.
judge.evidence_topic: A study designed to investigate the ability of individuals to differentiate between AI-generated and authentic food images, as well as the impact of disclosing this information on the consumer perception of the appeal of these images
judge.reason: O resumo confirma que os participantes acharam muito fácil reconhecer as imagens geradas por IA e que a divulgação da origem alterou o apelo: sem revelação as imagens de IA eram frequentemente preferidas, mas revelar que era genuína impulsionou o apelo, enquanto revelar que era IA mitigou o efeito.

items.title: De lo real a lo ficticio: evaluación de la credibilidad de noticias difundidas por humanos y por avatares creados con inteligencia artificial

judge.evidence_empirical: La investigación involucró a 150 estudiantes universitarios, quienes, mediante un diseño entre sujetos 3 x 1, observaron un video sobre un innovador invento médico.
judge.evidence_topic: avatares creados con inteligencia artificial
judge.reason: O artigo estuda a credibilidade de notícias apresentadas por avatares gerados por IA, o que está dentro do tema solicitado. Trata-se de um estudo experimental com partipantes humanos (dados próprios). O método descrito condiz com o resumo. O achado principal é diretamente sustentado pelo resumo, que relata diferença significativa entre humano e avatar realista e ausência de diferença entre humano e avatar ficcional.
